notes:
v2.7.2 is a small update about signing in.

Stay signed in after an update: when Dogbox restarts after installing an update (or after you change the network setting), it now comes back to the dashboard with you still signed in, instead of the sign-in page. This starts with the update after this one: installing 2.7.2 itself still ends on the sign-in page.

No automatic sign-out: Dogbox no longer signs you out by itself, for example when the computer has been asleep or the window has been closed for a while. You stay signed in until you click Sign out or close Dogbox, and tablets on your network stay signed in the same way. If others can use your computer, use its screen lock when you step away.
